alister-toon-gorlag.name: Evil Dragon Toons
alister-toon-gorlag.blurb: Alister's Toon deck in Waking the Dragons: Toon World, Toon Alligator, Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon, Toon Dark Magician Girl and Toon Masked Sorcerer, with the Seal of Orichalcos.

bakura-ryou-occult-thematic.name: Occult Deck
bakura-ryou-occult-thematic.blurb: In the games Ryou plays a horror and undead deck: Skull Servant, Headless Knight, Armored Zombie and Clown Zombie, with Curtain of the Dark Ones, Dark Plant and the monsters of his first cards. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
bakura-ryou-occult-thematic.basis: Bakura Ryou's "Occult Deck" in Yu-Gi-Oh! Nightmare Troubadour (Bakura Ryou wiki) plus the cards of his first deck in the Duel Monsters games.

espa-roba-esp-thematic.name: ESP Power
espa-roba-esp-thematic.blurb: Roba plays Jinzo, Cyber Raider, Reflect Bounder and The Fiend Megacyber with monster control cards (Brain Control, Mind Control, Mesmeric Control, Amplifier). It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
espa-roba-esp-thematic.basis: Espa Roba's "ESP Deck" in Yu-Gi-Oh! Nightmare Troubadour (Espa Roba wiki), which holds all eight cards of his anime deck in Battle City.

ishizu-ishtar-keepers-thematic.name: Tomb Keepers
ishizu-ishtar-keepers-thematic.blurb: Ishizu plays the Tomb Keepers: Agido, Zolga, Kelbek, Keldo, Mudora and Muko, with Spell Reproduction and Exchange of the Spirit. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
ishizu-ishtar-keepers-thematic.basis: Ishizu's "Keeper's Destiny" deck in Yu-Gi-Oh! Nightmare Troubadour (Ishizu Ishtar wiki) plus the Keepers and cards of her anime and manga list.

joey-battle-city-jinzo.name: Jinzo and Red-Eyes
joey-battle-city-jinzo.blurb: Joey's deck in Battle City: Jinzo, Gearfried, Panther Warrior, Time Wizard and Red-Eyes Black Dragon, with dice and gambles.

joey-duelist-kingdom-warriors.name: Warriors and Dragons
joey-duelist-kingdom-warriors.blurb: Joey's deck in Duelist Kingdom: Flame Swordsman, Panther Warrior, Time Wizard, Thousand Dragon and Black Skull Dragon.

joey-virtual-world-jinzo-warriors.name: Virtual World Warriors
joey-virtual-world-jinzo-warriors.blurb: Joey's deck in the Virtual World: Jinzo, Gearfried the Iron Knight, Panther Warrior and the dice cards Graceful Dice and Skull Dice.

joey-waking-dragons-red-eyes.name: Red-Eyes and Warriors
joey-waking-dragons-red-eyes.blurb: Joey's deck in Waking the Dragons: Red-Eyes Black Dragon, Lord of the Red, Jinzo, Gearfried the Swordmaster and Red-Eyes Black Dragon Sword.

kaiba-battle-city-blue-eyes.name: Blue-Eyes and Thunder Dragon
kaiba-battle-city-blue-eyes.blurb: Kaiba's deck in Battle City: three Blue-Eyes White Dragon, Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, Obelisk, the Thunder Dragon fusion and the Dragon Summoning Flute.

kaiba-duelist-kingdom-blue-eyes.name: Blue-Eyes and Lord of D.
kaiba-duelist-kingdom-blue-eyes.blurb: Kaiba's deck in Duelist Kingdom: three Blue-Eyes White Dragon, Lord of D. with the Flute of Summoning Dragon, Judge Man and Saggi the Dark Clown.

kaiba-pyramid-of-light-dragons.name: Blue-Eyes and Dragon Machines
kaiba-pyramid-of-light-dragons.blurb: Kaiba's deck in the Pyramid of Light movie: three Blue-Eyes White Dragon, Blue-Eyes Shining Dragon, Luster Dragon and the XYZ-Dragon Cannon line.

kaiba-virtual-world-dragons.name: Virtual World Dragons
kaiba-virtual-world-dragons.blurb: Kaiba's deck in the Virtual World: Blue-Eyes White Dragon x3, Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, Kaiser Sea Horse and Thunder Dragon, with Ring of Destruction and Crush Card Virus.

kaiba-waking-dragons-tyrant.name: Blue-Eyes and Tyrant Dragon
kaiba-waking-dragons-tyrant.blurb: Kaiba's deck in Waking the Dragons: Blue-Eyes White Dragon x3, Ultimate, Tyrant Dragon, Doom Virus Dragon and the Pitch-Dark / Y-Dragon / Z-Metal Tank line.

mai-battle-city-amazoness-harpies.name: Amazoness and Harpies
mai-battle-city-amazoness-harpies.blurb: Mai's deck in Battle City: the Amazoness (Fighter, Swords Woman, Chain Master, Spellcaster and Archers) alongside Harpie Lady, Cyber Harpie Lady and Elegant Egotist.

mai-harpie-ladies-video.name: Harpie Ladies
mai-harpie-ladies-video.blurb: Mai's Harpie Ladies: Cyber Harpie Lady, Harpie Lady Sisters, Harpie Pet Dragon, Harpie Feather Duster and Elegant Egotist. List from the Stairway to the Destined Duel wiki (the wiki has no anime list large enough).

mai-nightmare-troubadour-poison-lady.name: Poison Lady
mai-nightmare-troubadour-poison-lady.blurb: Mai from Nightmare Troubadour: Harpie Lady 2 and 3, Cyber Harpie Lady, Birdface, Elegant Egotist and Triangle Ecstasy Spark. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
mai-nightmare-troubadour-poison-lady.basis: Mai's "Poison Lady" deck in Yu-Gi-Oh! Nightmare Troubadour (Mai Valentine wiki, Deck Recipe): her Harpie strategy with Birdface, Elegant Egotist and Triangle Ecstasy Spark.

mai-waking-dragons-harpie-phoenix.name: Harpies and Orichalcos
mai-waking-dragons-harpie-phoenix.blurb: Mai's deck in Waking the Dragons: Cyber Harpie Lady, Harpie Lady Sisters, Harpie Lady Phoenix Formation, Harpie's Feather Storm and the Seal of Orichalcos.

mako-dawn-of-destiny-sea.name: Tide of Fish
mako-dawn-of-destiny-sea.blurb: Mako from The Dawn of Destiny: a sea creature deck (7 Colored Fish, Crazy Fish, Flying Fish, Giant Red Seasnake) with Umi, Tornado Wall and Torrential Tribute. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
mako-dawn-of-destiny-sea.basis: Mako's deck in Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dawn of Destiny (Mako Tsunami wiki): fish and sea beasts supported by Umi.

mako-legendary-ocean-video.name: Legendary Ocean
mako-legendary-ocean-video.blurb: Mako's sea deck: The Legendary Fisherman x3, A Legendary Ocean, 7 Colored Fish, Flying Fish and Giant Red Seasnake with Torrential Tribute. List from the World Championship 2004 wiki (the anime ones have 12 cards).

mako-nightmare-troubadour-sea-stealth.name: Sea Stealth
mako-nightmare-troubadour-sea-stealth.blurb: Mako from Nightmare Troubadour with the monsters of his anime deck: Fortress Whale, Great White, Jellyfish, The Legendary Fisherman, Umi and Torrential Tribute. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
mako-nightmare-troubadour-sea-stealth.basis: Mako's "Sea Stealth" deck in Yu-Gi-Oh! Nightmare Troubadour (Mako Tsunami wiki) plus the cards of his anime deck in Battle City.

marik-ishtar-ra-jam-thematic.name: Ra and Jam
marik-ishtar-ra-jam-thematic.blurb: In Yu-Gi-Oh! Nightmare Troubadour Marik plays The Winged Dragon of Ra with undead monsters, and in the anime Jam Breeding Machine, Humanoid Slime and Nightmare's Steelcage. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
marik-ishtar-ra-jam-thematic.basis: Marik's "Roar of Ra" deck in Yu-Gi-Oh! Nightmare Troubadour (Marik Ishtar wiki) plus the cards of his anime deck in Battle City (Humanoid Slime, Jam Breeding Machine, Nightmare's Steelcage).

mokuba-kaiba-animals-thematic.name: Beasts and Toons
mokuba-kaiba-animals-thematic.blurb: In the games Mokuba plays a deck of small beasts (Griffore, Torike, Des Koala, Krokodilus) with Toon Alligator and animal support cards. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
mokuba-kaiba-animals-thematic.basis: Mokuba's "It's Mokuba!" deck in Yu-Gi-Oh! Nightmare Troubadour (Mokuba Kaiba wiki): there is no 40-card list of his in the anime.

noah-kaiba-shinato-thematic.name: Shinato and Divine Ark
noah-kaiba-shinato-thematic.blurb: Noah plays Shinato, King of a Higher Plane and Shinato's Ark with the spirits and guardians of his virtual world (Chiron the Mage, Giant Soldier of Stone, Asura Priest). It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
noah-kaiba-shinato-thematic.basis: Noah's "Divine Ark" deck in Yu-Gi-Oh! Nightmare Troubadour (Noah Kaiba wiki) plus the cards of his Creation and Spirit decks from the anime.

odion-trap-guardian-thematic.name: Temple Traps
odion-trap-guardian-thematic.blurb: Odion plays traps: Embodiment of Apophis, Judgment of Anubis, Temple of the Kings and Mystical Beast of Serket. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
odion-trap-guardian-thematic.basis: Odion's "Temple Lurker" deck in Yu-Gi-Oh! Nightmare Troubadour (Odion wiki) plus the cards of his anime deck (Curse of Anubis, De-Spell, Swords of Revealing Light).

pegasus-duelist-kingdom-toons-illusion.name: Toons and Thousand-Eyes
pegasus-duelist-kingdom-toons-illusion.blurb: Pegasus's deck in Duelist Kingdom: Toon World, Toon Summoned Skull, Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon, Relinquished and Thousand-Eyes Restrict.

pegasus-pyramid-of-light-toons.name: Toon World
pegasus-pyramid-of-light-toons.blurb: Pegasus's deck in the movie: Toon World, Toon Summoned Skull, Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon, Relinquished and Thousand-Eyes Restrict.

pegasus-stairway-relinquished-thousand-e.name: Relinquished and Thousand-Eyes
pegasus-stairway-relinquished-thousand-e.blurb: Pegasus from Stairway to the Destined Duel: Relinquished, Thousand-Eyes Idol and Restrict, Black Illusion Ritual, Toon World and Numinous Healer. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
pegasus-stairway-relinquished-thousand-e.basis: Pegasus's deck in Yu-Gi-Oh! Worldwide Edition: Stairway to the Destined Duel (Maximillion Pegasus wiki): his Duelist Kingdom cards, Relinquished and Thousand-Eyes, with the Toons.

rex-dawn-of-destiny-dragons.name: Dinosaurs and Dragons
rex-dawn-of-destiny-dragons.blurb: Rex from The Dawn of Destiny: dinosaurs and small dragons (Two-Headed King Rex, Crawling Dragon #2, Uraby, Megazowler) with Polymerization. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
rex-dawn-of-destiny-dragons.basis: Rex's deck in Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dawn of Destiny (Rex Raptor wiki): his classic strategy of dinosaurs and low-level dragons.

rex-dinosaurs-video.name: Dinosaurs
rex-dinosaurs-video.blurb: Rex's dinosaurs: Two-Headed King Rex, Megazowler, Uraby, Crawling Dragon #2 and Sword Arm of Dragon. List from the Dark Duel Stories wiki (the anime ones have only 8 cards).

rex-nightmare-troubadour-raptor-rampage.name: Raptor Rampage
rex-nightmare-troubadour-raptor-rampage.blurb: Rex from Nightmare Troubadour: Two-Headed King Rex, Uraby, Crawling Dragon #2 and Red-Eyes Black Dragon, with the dinosaurs of Waking the Dragons (Tyrant Dragon, Giant Rex). It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
rex-nightmare-troubadour-raptor-rampage.basis: Rex's "Raptor Rampage" deck in Yu-Gi-Oh! Nightmare Troubadour (Rex Raptor wiki) plus the dinosaurs of his anime deck in Waking the Dragons.

tristan-taylor-warriors-machines-themati.name: Warriors and Machines
tristan-taylor-warriors-machines-themati.blurb: In the games Tristan plays a deck of warriors and attack beasts with Goblin Attack Force, and in the Virtual World he uses Cyber Commander, Launcher Spider and Super Roboyarou. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
tristan-taylor-warriors-machines-themati.basis: Tristan's deck in Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dawn of Destiny (Tristan Taylor wiki) plus the cards of his Virtual World deck from the anime.

weevil-battle-city-ultimate-moth.name: Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth
weevil-battle-city-ultimate-moth.blurb: Weevil's deck in Battle City: Larvae Moth and Cocoon of Evolution to evolve into Great Moth and Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth, with Insect Queen and Pinch Hopper.

weevil-insects-video.name: Insects
weevil-insects-video.blurb: Weevil's swarm: Larvae Moth, Great Moth, Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth, Insect Queen, Killer Needle and Basic Insect. List from the Dark Duel Stories wiki (the anime ones are too short).

weevil-nightmare-troubadour-bug-queen.name: Bug Queen
weevil-nightmare-troubadour-bug-queen.blurb: Weevil from Nightmare Troubadour: Insect Queen, Pinch Hopper, Parasite Paracide, Jirai Gumo and Insect Barrier. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
weevil-nightmare-troubadour-bug-queen.basis: Weevil's "Bug Queen Deck" in Yu-Gi-Oh! Nightmare Troubadour (Weevil Underwood wiki): Insect Queen with Pinch Hopper, Parasite Paracide and DNA Surgery.

yami-bakura-battle-city-spirits.name: Spirits and Ouija Board
yami-bakura-battle-city-spirits.blurb: Bakura's deck in Battle City: Dark Necrofear, Earthbound Spirit, the four Spirit Message cards and Destiny Board. It is completed with the cards we already saw him play in Duelist Kingdom.

yami-bakura-nightmare-troubadour-underwo.name: Underworld Ruler and Diabound
yami-bakura-nightmare-troubadour-underwo.blurb: Bakura from Nightmare Troubadour (Dark Necrofear, Headless Knight, The Earl of Demise) with the cards of his Memory World duel: Diabound Kernel, The Duke of Demise and Grief Tablet. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
yami-bakura-nightmare-troubadour-underwo.basis: Yami Bakura's "Underworld Ruler" deck in Yu-Gi-Oh! Nightmare Troubadour (Yami Bakura wiki) plus the cards of his Memory World deck from the anime (Diabound).

yami-bakura-wc-2008-vampires.name: Unlit Banquet (Vampires)
yami-bakura-wc-2008-vampires.blurb: Bakura from World Championship 2008: a Vampire deck (Vampire Lord, Vampire Lady, Vampire Genesis, Vampire's Curse) and undead with Book of Life and Call of the Mummy. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck shown in the anime.
yami-bakura-wc-2008-vampires.basis: Yami Bakura's "Unlit Banquet" deck in Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2008 (Yami Bakura wiki): his undead and Vampire side, apart from the spirits and Ouija Board deck of the anime.

yami-yugi-dawn-of-the-duel-knights.name: Magicians and Gods of the Final Duel
yami-yugi-dawn-of-the-duel-knights.blurb: The Pharaoh's deck in the Ceremonial Duel: Dark Magician, Dark Magician Girl, the Knights, Gazelle and the three Egyptian Gods.

yami-yugi-vjump-dark-yugi-goat.name: Atem: Goat-style Control
yami-yugi-vjump-dark-yugi-goat.blurb: The "Dark Yugi (Atem)" deck from V Jump magazine: Dark Magician, Buster Blader and Slifer with the small monsters and support of the Goat era (Giant Germ, Mystic Tomato, Nimble Momonga). It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck from the anime.
yami-yugi-vjump-dark-yugi-goat.basis: The "Dark Yugi (Atem) Deck" list published by V Jump magazine (Yami Yugi wiki): a tournament list with the monsters and support cards of the Goat era and Yugi's signature cards.

yami-yugi-waking-dragons-knights.name: Legendary Knights
yami-yugi-waking-dragons-knights.blurb: Yugi's deck in Waking the Dragons: the Legendary Knights Timaeus, Critias and Hermos, Dark Magician Girl, the Kuriboh family and the Egyptian Gods.

yami-yugi-world-championship-2016-atem.name: Atem: Championship Magicians
yami-yugi-world-championship-2016-atem.blurb: Atem's deck in the scripted Yugi vs. Kaiba duel of the 2016 World Championship: Dark Magician of Chaos, Magician of Dark Illusion, Mahad, Black Luster Soldier and the three Egyptian Gods. It is a playable version with printed cards, not a deck from the anime.
yami-yugi-world-championship-2016-atem.basis: Atem's official list in the scripted Yugi vs. Kaiba duel of the 2016 Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship (Yami Yugi wiki, Scripted Duels): magicians, Kuriboh and the Egyptian Gods.

yugi-battle-city-gods.name: Dark Magician and Egyptian Gods
yugi-battle-city-gods.blurb: Yugi's deck in Battle City: Dark Magician, Dark Magician Girl, the Magician's Knights and the three Egyptian Gods, with control traps and spells.

yugi-dark-side-of-dimensions-magicians.name: Dimension Magicians
yugi-dark-side-of-dimensions-magicians.blurb: Yugi's deck in The Dark Side of Dimensions: Silent Magician, Silent Swordsman, the Magician family, Marshmacaron and the Dimension traps.

yugi-duelist-kingdom-exodia.name: Magicians and Exodia
yugi-duelist-kingdom-exodia.blurb: The grandpa's deck with which Yugi wins Duelist Kingdom: Dark Magician, Summoned Skull and the five pieces of Exodia. It is almost a deck of one copy of each card, as in the series.

yugi-grand-championship-gods-knights.name: Magicians, Knights and Gods
yugi-grand-championship-gods-knights.blurb: Yugi's deck in the Grand Championship: Dark Magician, Dark Paladin, Buster Blader, the Knights and the Egyptian Gods.

yugi-pyramid-of-light-magicians.name: Magicians and the Pharaoh's Knights
yugi-pyramid-of-light-magicians.blurb: Yugi's deck in the Pyramid of Light movie: Dark Magician, Dark Magician Girl, Skilled Dark Magician, Magician's Valkyria and the three Egyptian Gods.

yugi-virtual-world-blue-eyes.name: Magicians and Blue-Eyes
yugi-virtual-world-blue-eyes.blurb: Yugi's deck in the Virtual World: the usual magicians with Black Luster Soldier, Black Chaos the Magical Warrior and the three Blue-Eyes White Dragon he uses in the duel against the Big Five.

adrian-cloud-cloudian.name: Cloudian
adrian-cloud-cloudian.blurb: Adrian's deck: Cloudian that gather Fog Counters under Summon Cloud, with Cloudian - Eye of the Typhoon and Diamond-Dust Cyclone as finishers.

adrian-exodia.name: Exodia
adrian-exodia.blurb: Adrian's Exodia deck: drawing the five pieces of the Forbidden One with Break the Seal and Deep Diver while Fog King and Dimensional Prison buy him time, with Exodius as a second way to win.

alexis-cyber-girl-cyber-angel.name: Cyber Girl
alexis-cyber-girl-cyber-angel.blurb: Alexis's deck: the Cyber Girls (Cyber Tutu, Cyber Prima, Etoile Cyber) and the Ritual Cyber Angels, with Cyber Blader as the Fusion.

aster-hero-destiny-hero.name: Destiny HERO
aster-hero-destiny-hero.blurb: The deck of the Neo Spacian Phoenix champion: Destiny HEROs with D Cubed and Destiny Draw, and Elemental HERO Phoenix Enforcer as the final ace.

atticus-dragon-red-eyes.name: Dragons
atticus-dragon-red-eyes.blurb: Atticus's deck before Nightshroud: dragons with Troop Dragon and Spear Dragon, and Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon with Red-Eyes Black Dragon as the signature card.

axel-volcanic.name: Volcanic
axel-volcanic.blurb: Axel's deck: Volcanic FIRE monsters like Volcanic Rat, Scattershot and Doomfire, with Infernal Flame Emperor and the direct damage of FIRE effects.

bastion-7th-chemistry-ritual.name: Chemistry and Ritual
bastion-7th-chemistry-ritual.blurb: Bastion's deck against the Seven Stars: Hydrogeddon, Oxygeddon and Carboneddon combine with Bonding - H2O and with Litmus Doom Swordsman, the chemistry Ritual.

bastion-water-earth-magnet.name: Water and Earth
bastion-water-earth-magnet.blurb: Bastion's deck that mixes Hydrogeddon and Oxygeddon with the EARTH Magnet Warriors and the Conduction Warriors.

camula-vampire-thematic.name: Undead Vampires
camula-vampire-thematic.blurb: Camula, the vampire Shadow Rider, raises her undead from the Graveyard again and again with Vampire Genesis and Book of Life. The deck gathers the Vampires she uses and fills out with real Vampire lists.
camula-vampire-thematic.basis: Camula plays a Vampire/Zombie deck of constant recovery (wiki, episodes 31-33). The deck gathers the monsters the anime shows (the ones that exist in the TCG) and those of her deck in Legacy of the Duelist, and fills out with real Master Duel Vampire lists.
